purpose: Distinguish the single active 4-day Canaima tour that visits the Churun River from general sightseeing at Canaima Lagoon, using canonical tour and excursion data.

externalSources.supports: Official UNESCO description of the Canaima National Park tepui landscape, cliffs and waterfalls.

notes: Only one approved 4-day tour verified as visiting Churun as a main destination.
Exact river route, trekking and included services derived from current active tour and excursion MD, not assumed from generic travel sites.
Costs not hardcoded into the SEO article, while park fees and optional excursions are described by their inclusion category.
Public body uses contextual internal canonical links only.
